Stainless Steel Pipe Fittings
How to Measure Pipe Size for NPT or BSP Threads—Example shows pipe size ³/8.

Pipe size is not an actual measured size, but rather an industry designation.Alignyourpipe or fittingwith the"O" line as shown.The line on the opposite edge gives the pipe size. You can also measure the OD of male threads or the ID of female threads, then find the corresponding pipe size in the chart. If your measurement doesn't match an OD or ID listed, round to the nearest 1/8".
To measure larger pipe sizes, go to mcmaster.com and search for 4464KAC. For information about fittings and pipe, see pages 2-3.
